title: Guess How Many Views One Trailer Got in a Day 🎬 #shorts
description:
Guess how many times one movie trailer got watched in a single day. Comment a number.

The first Spider-Man: Brand New Day trailer (March 2026) beat the old 24-hour record (365 million, Deadpool & Wolverine) in just 8 hours and reached 718.6 million views in 24 hours, then 1 billion in four days. The Avengers: Doomsday trailer is second with 503 million. Doomsday hits cinemas on 18 December.

Sources: Motion Picture Association (The Credits), Variety, SlashFilm, GamesRadar
